summary: A small shoaling fish of Amazonian blackwater and clearwater streams. Its blue stripe sits above a red band confined to the rear half of the body, unlike the longer red band of a cardinal tetra.

features: Reflective blue stripe along the upper side.
Red lower stripe begins around the middle of the body and continues towards the tail.
Silver-white belly and mostly transparent fins.

lookAlikes.difference: The cardinal has a red stripe running along most of the lower body; the neon has red mainly on its rear half.

habitat.description: Dark blackwater and clearwater forest streams.
habitat.diet: An omnivore that accepts suitably small prepared foods and small invertebrates.
